models.user: The signed-in person, as synced from the tenant's identity provider on the last sign-in.
models.breakGlassUser: The tenant's break-glass administrator account. Its account page shows Change password and Authenticator blocks instead of Preferences and roles.
models.passwordPolicy: The shared password rule shown on the break-glass Change password block. Rule 4 is checked only when saving.
models.authenticatorEnrolledAt: Break-glass only: when the current authenticator app was enrolled.
models.group: A group the person belongs to, from the directory or created locally by an administrator.
models.session: An active browser session of the person. One is the current one.
models.preference: The person's overrides of the tenant defaults for language, time zone, and theme, with the tenant defaults alongside.
models.roleGrant: A role the person holds, with the scope it applies to.
models.notification: An inbox item written by a module event. Read when readAt is set.
models.idleTimeout: The idle-timeout state that drives the countdown modal.
models.tenantSupport: The tenant's support contact shown in empty states.

relationships: user has many sessions, exactly one with isCurrent true
